mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns during declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5 percent, it signals severe labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5 or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor of negative returns is less than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) fails to predict positive 20-day returns with Rank IC > 0.03 in any 3-year window or positive return rate drops below 55% when both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: In early recession regimes characterized by industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100), manufacturing weakness signals economic slowdown and corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return during INDPRO < 100 periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime falls below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) reflects robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 as predictor of 60-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 60-day returns during positive GDPC1 growth are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5 percent, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual rate > 2.5 or Rank IC for inflation rate as predictor of negative returns is less than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (PAYEMS growth * (-UNRATE change)) fails to predict positive 20-day returns with Rank IC > 0.03 in any 3-year window or positive return rate drops below 55% when both conditions hold.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes characterized by housing starts (HOUST) above the 5-year moving average, residential construction activity signals broader economic improvement and increased consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return during HOUST > 5-year MA periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for HOUST in this regime falls below 0.03.
